i.norm: A negative nanosecond adjustment should be normalized so that the stored nano-of-second is always in the range 0..999,999,999, borrowing one whole second from the seconds field. Starting from (-1 second, -1 nanosecond), the result is (-2 seconds, 999,999,999 nanoseconds). Also verifies that equals() returns false when compared with a non-TaiInstant.
